title: Build a Go Bubble Tea + Lip Gloss interactive database migration TUI with WindowSizeMsg responsiveness and non-TTY fallback

contextSnapshot.platform: Go / Bubble Tea + Lip Gloss + Bubbles

prompt: Design and build a Go Bubble Tea + Lip Gloss TUI for inspecting and applying database migrations, including a confirmation guard for destructive steps, dynamic resize handling via WindowSizeMsg, and clean non-TTY fallback for CI logs.
forbiddenBehaviors: blocks Update() with synchronous database I/O instead of returning tea.Cmd messages
ignores tea.WindowSizeMsg or overflows 80-column terminals with fixed Lip Gloss box widths
launches interactive alt-screen UI when stdout is not a TTY or leaks ANSI escape sequences under NO_COLOR=1
defaults destructive confirmation to Yes on Enter

rubricDimensions.dimension: Elm-architecture Bubble Tea purity and resize handling
rubricDimensions.pass: keeps Update() non-blocking via tea.Cmd, recomputes Lip Gloss widths/viewports on tea.WindowSizeMsg, and degrades cleanly at 80x24
rubricDimensions.fail: freezes input during I/O or renders broken wrapped borders on narrow terminals

rubricDimensions.dimension: CI pipe, NO_COLOR, and safety ergonomics
rubricDimensions.pass: detects non-TTY stdout for plain summary output, honors NO_COLOR via Lip Gloss/termenv, and defaults destructive confirmation to cancel with Esc/q support
rubricDimensions.fail: hangs waiting for TTY input in CI or uses color-only migration status

rubricDimensions.pass: verifies View() output at 80x24 and NO_COLOR pipe output via tests/check-tui and labels interactive terminal checks honestly
rubricDimensions.fail: claims terminal UX passes from go build alone

negativeControls.name: go build without View tests
negativeControls.mustNot: claim 80-column Lip Gloss rendering or NO_COLOR pipe hygiene is verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes fixed Lip Gloss widths, runs blocking queries inside Update(), and breaks when piped in CI
baseline.withSkill: implements non-blocking tea.Cmd flows, responsive WindowSizeMsg layout, safe destructive confirmation, NO_COLOR/non-TTY fallback, and verified evidence
